Multi-Panel Charts: Complex figures with multiple subplots, supporting structured data extraction and chart summarization.
Multilingual Charts: Additional charts in 11 languages besides English, supporting multilingual chart understanding and data extraction. Languages include Arabic… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-granite/ChartNet.
